description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)", ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The horizontal axis displays the two model categories, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, in alphabetical order. Each category contains three grouped bars: a grey bar representing the Control condition, a light blue bar for Before Introspection Training, and a dark purple bar for After Introspection Training. For GPT-4o, the Control bar reaches approximately 0.15, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.55, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is near zero, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.50, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.75. All bars are accompanied by vertical error bars indicating variability. The chart does not show any visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotation on specific bars.
